description: Land Acquisition - Atambagoda D/S Division, Kalutara District, -  Udahamulla, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District.
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, boundaries, extents, and claimants) for public purposes such as creating a water reservoir, park, and parking lot. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette.
